title: Qualify runtime ICU 78 Unicode 17 without direct linkage

criteria: Compare all Unicode scalars and all eleven replacement properties plus lower upper title fold against the unchanged pinned Rust compiler; review differences.
Run fresh private stdlib consumer with actual system ICU 78; preserve Windows and older Linux contracts, fixed system directories, fail-closed behavior and no direct ICU imports.
Run affected host IDNA and regex runtime tests; acquire actual Opus contribution and Argon review.
Recheck actual consumer on cached Linux sysroot admission without weakening source or artifact guards.

progress: Actual Claude Opus 5.5 designed the audit and category-based scalar-title fix; actual Gemini 4 Argon High source review and final Windows audit review approved with zero blockers.

Final Linux audit passes all 1,112,064 scalars, eleven properties and lower, upper, title and fold conversions with zero mismatches or panics. Georgian, U+0345, titlecase-letter and expansion regressions pass.
Final Windows audit passes 287,346 assigned scalars and the reviewed 70 differences. The original 71 to 70 delta removes only U+0345; all other difference lines remain byte-identical.
Fresh changed private sysroot and real Linux cache-hit consumers pass. Measured warm cached admission with recompilation and consumer execution took 0.742 seconds on the qualification host.
IDNA runtime tests pass 8 of 8; OS regex Unicode tests pass 3 of 3; regex-syntax tests pass 143 unit and 48 doc tests. The focused ICU ELF import policy test and two trusted-sysroot tests pass.
The full ELF suite has 8 passes and one unrelated OpenSSL path failure. Scoped clippy is blocked by three pre-existing susi-config host_metrics useless-conversion lints. These are separate claims.
Formatting and diff checks pass. No complete integration gate, publication, release, promotion or portable Linux baseline is claimed.

qualification.remaining: Desktop integration and combined-tree gates; final artifact and declared baseline qualification; no direct execution against Linux ICU 72, 74 or 76 on this host.
